producer_report.summary: The firstmate study page now defines yolo, green, red, in scope, places and home once, in Words used first and the Glossary. Everywhere else it links to them. I added a `linked()` helper that turns `[[term]]` in study text into a link to that term's Glossary entry. I applied it to the intro items, lead-ins, start terms, deciders, summaries, trigger, guard, failure text and Glossary definitions. I cut or linked the repeated wording in the overview, the failure list, the t2, t10 and t11 summaries, the glossary entries for exit 75, secondmate, captain and place, and the t10 trigger and guard. I reworded the t10 guard in model.json so it no longer echoes the red definition. Two tests render the real page. One checks that each term has one Glossary entry and that every `#term-` link has a matching id. The other fails when any run of 6 or more words from a definition appears elsewhere on the page. `cargo test --locked` and clippy pass; I ran cargo fmt --all after one formatting failure and did not re-run the check.
